SOLAR LEASE AGREEMENT

This Solar Lease Agreement is entered into as of May 18, 2026 between Sunward Home Energy, Inc. ("Provider") and Dana Whitfield ("Homeowner").

1. System. Provider will install solar panels on the roof of Homeowner's house and will own them.

2. Payment. Homeowner will pay Provider $139 each month.

3. Maintenance. Provider will maintain the solar panels.

4. No Cancellation. Homeowner waives any right to cancel this Agreement once it is signed.

5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Nevada.

SUNWARD HOME ENERGY, INC.
